Name: VSX Deck
Author: VSX Deck
Description: Slate VSX from the Stream Deck: ON/OFF, room slots, Save and level-matched Bypass. Keys show what the live VSX applied.

Actions.Name: VSX On/Off
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle VSX. Amber outline = not confirmed by a running VSX.

Actions.Name: VSX Slot
Actions.Tooltip: Load a room slot (green = active). Hold 1.5 s to clear. Slot number: settings.slot (set by the installer).

Actions.Name: VSX Bypass
Actions.Tooltip: VSX's own level-matched bypass (VSX keeps running). Amber = bypassed.

Actions.Name: VSX Save
Actions.Tooltip: Save the open VSX window's settings into the selected slot.
